column1: # Divergence registry: deliberate differences from MuJoCo 3.5.0, each with the test that shows it. Every
# `divergence=<ID>` note in verdicts.tsv names an ID here (mujoco_conformance/layer_e_census.rs checks it);
# a row no note names is a difference no census doc exercises.
# kind: stricter (we refuse what MuJoCo accepts) · limitation (MuJoCo does what we cannot) ·
#       no-effect (accepted, with no effect) · lenient (we load where MuJoCo wrongly refuses) ·
#       wrong-value (MuJoCo computes a wrong value; the test shows ours is right) ·
#       extension (what MuJoCo does not have: a quantity, a file format, a file past its limits).

column3: MuJoCo
column4: ours

column3: loads a NaN or an infinity written in a number (measured: a body's pos and quat, a joint's axis, damping and range, a geom's friction, a motor's ctrlrange, keyframe values, a tendon's springlength, <option> numbers, a fixed tendon's joint coef, an infinite geom size, a NaN written with a payload such as nan(1)), except where its compiler refuses the value (measured: a NaN geom size, a capsule's NaN fromto, a non-finite mesh vertex, a NaN mass or density on a moving body); on <compiler><lengthrange> a NaN or infinite accel, a NaN timeconst or an infinite inttotal never returns (its length-range run does not end: measured to 120 s); refuses a number past its type's range ("number is too large": a double's, or a float's for an attribute it reads as float); its URDF importer the same (measured: a joint's <limit lower="-inf"> loads, jnt_range -inf 1; a mesh scale "inf 1 1" is read)
column4: refuses a NaN or an infinity written in any number it reads (sim-urdf's reader too, a URDF number), naming the element and attribute (and Model::set_length_range an infinite inttotal where an actuator's run needs it, LengthRangeError::InfiniteInttotal, where MuJoCo's run never ends; its other options run as MuJoCo's comparisons take them), and a number past its type's range as MuJoCo refuses it; a model built in code or read from .mjb is checked only where validation and the builder check it: keyframe values, a fixed tendon's joint coef, an inertial's mass and diaginertia, a geom's size and fromto, a site's size, and the <option> numbers timestep, tolerance, impratio, regularization, friction_smoothing, gravity, wind, density, viscosity and o_margin
